source: Nova Scotia Communications Technology 11 and 12 Guide (DRAFT, November 2009)
note: The guide covers both Grade 11 and Grade 12. Each outcome is tagged grade "11" or "12" where the guide states it, or "11/12" where unmarked. Module 1 is integrated throughout; Module 2 (Digital Photography) is a mandatory module.
